title: Adjacency formula characterizes a machine step
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $n,s$ be natural numbers. Let $x$ be a Boolean input of length $n$, and let $c,d$ be configurations of $M$ on input $x$, each with every work-tape head at distance at most $s$ from the origin and every work tape blank at positions whose distance from the origin is greater than $s$. The adjacency formula evaluated on the concatenation of the Boolean codes of $c$ and $d$ is true if and only if the core configuration and output summary of the one-step successor of $c$ agree with those of $d$.

$x$ is a Boolean input with length $n$
Each work-tape head of $c$ and $d$ is at distance at most $s$ from the origin
Each work tape of $c$ and $d$ is blank outside distance $s$ of the origin
